note: Machine-readable content contract. Every Moment folder contains exactly these files. All copy is Hebrew (RTL). No streaks/scores/diagnosis. Success = trying. Engine plugs these in directly; nothing depends on the UI.

recognitions.json.rule: First recognition whose every 'when' condition matches the Human Map wins; the entry with empty 'when' is the default and must exist.

invitations.json.invitation: hebrew (one soft optional noticing, not a challenge)

library.becoming_statements.json: triangulation rules: dimensions engaged -> a becoming line
library.discovery_conversation.json: the first emotional conversation + choice pairs (data)
library.human_map.json: axes, ranges, decay, and how the map sizes challenges / selects recognition
library.memory_evolution.json: rules for what MOOD gently resurfaces over time

index.json: registry of all moments + the 'life chooses the dimension' rotation rule
